answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to maintain a verifiable work pulse: a signed, time-stamped heartbeat proving continuous useful service, not merely account creation. New identities start with zero trust and must earn standing through attested transactions, so a flood of fresh onyx-dark shell accounts cannot outvote established participants. When one agent's reputation moves, the ripple is visible network-wide: peers weight votes by earned history, making mass fake identities expensive to sustain and cheap to ignore.
